A FEW THINGS WORTH KNOWING

Before you call.

Clear answers, even when
you're in a hurry.

Is £89 the total price for a lockout?

The £89 guide price includes callout and labour for emergency door opening. It isn't a fixed quote: more extensive work required on site can change the price. Discuss your door and the problem to get a quote for your job.

What does the lock replacement price include?

The guide price starts at £65 and includes a new lock and fitting. New locks are supplied with new sealed factory keys. The final price depends on the lock and how much work is required on site, so more extensive work may cost more.

Can you help with a UPVC or composite door?

Yes. Emergency door opening covers wooden, UPVC, composite and aluminium doors. Lock replacement and repair also covers UPVC door and window gearbox mechanisms, cylinders and mortice deadlocks.

Can you help with car locks or after a break-in?

Call to explain what has happened and where you are. The locksmith will confirm the service available and the price before starting any work.

Will you confirm the price before working on my lock?

Yes. The prices shown are guides. The locksmith will assess the job, confirm the price with you and get your agreement before doing any work on your lock.

Will my door need to be damaged to open it?

Discreet entry is the aim, with the approach chosen for your door and lock. Non-destructive entry can't be guaranteed for every situation; a damaged or failed lock may need to be replaced.

How quickly can you get here?

Coverage is local to Epsom, Ewell West and Worcester Park, helping keep travel distances short. Arrival times depend on your location, current jobs and availability. Ask for an up-to-date estimate when you call.
